item.title: Re: Does this SCP exist already?
item.content:encoded:
That would be the meta tag- "SCP affects or is affected by its documentation, or requires containment procedures regarding the way it is documented."

Fair warning, you'll probably want to have a really solid grasp on the format and what's been done before if you want to pull off that sort of article.

item.title: Does this SCP exist already?
item.content:encoded: Is there an SCP where the SCP itself writes, edits, or corrupts the article? I just wanted to check if this idea exists before I begin the idea critique.
